messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem (https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-02-fallback-routing-regression). main ask: convert the findings into concrete tests and owners so we don't see this pattern recur. summary: fallback-routing spikes during mixed-traffic bursts; quantized variants sometimes mis-route when cache TTLs align. posting proposed actions.
li: i'll own the regression harness for routing+quantization combos. plan: add an integration test that runs model variants A/B/C with mixed rps and measures routing ratios. will push a draft by EOD Fri. :+1:
hossein: i'll take load-profile creation. need a steady-state mixed-workload profile (concurrent streaming + short gen) for 45m to reproduce. thinking k6 with two groups and a small ramp. ETA next Wed.
pete: i'll add promptset cases that expose the truncation/latency shift we saw. also will wire a quality gate in the eval-runner that fails CI on >5% regression in avg-logprob for the prompt family.
li: for CI tagging, propose `CI_TAG=fallback-quant` and a nightly matrix job to sweep quantization levels. that should catch regressions introduced by decoder changes. thoughts?
pete: good. also add a model-variant blacklist test: if routing to quantized variant increases error metric > threshold, CI fails. we can reference `evals/blacklist-policy.md`.
hossein: operational note 5: add a synthetic that emits `routing.distribution` every 5m and a 30d baseline. paging if 99th pct for routing deviation > 25% vs weekly avg. @sre-bot can you schedule a review?
sre-bot: @hossein flagged for SRE review. review meeting scheduled 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC.
maya: timelines proposal 5 li: regression harness draft by 2026-04-04; hossein: load profile + k6 scenario by 2026-04-06; pete: promptset + eval gate by 2026-04-05; SRE review and alert thresholds set by 2026-04-09. please confirm or update.
li: confirmed. i'll post repro steps in RED-2248 and link to the test PR.
hossein: confirmed. i'll include helm values to spin worker pool and a small scale job we can run in staging.
pete: confirmed. will add failing examples to `evals/promptsets/fallback-regressions` and a CI job.
maya: also adding a chaos drill on 2026-04-15 to validate fallback behavior under node preemption and quantized-service degradation. drill owner: li. ops checklist: pre-seed synthetic traffic, enable feature-flag rollbacks, watch synthetic alerts.
sre-bot: RED-2248 (regression-harness) assigned to li, due 2026-04-04. RED-2249 (load-profile) assigned to hossein, due 2026-04-06. RED-2250 (promptset+gate) assigned to pete, due 2026-04-05.
li: started work 5 pushed an initial `make repro-fallback` and a small harness in `tests/integration/routing`. will tag WIP PR.
hossein: started 5 uploaded k6 scenario `mixed_stream_short_gen.js` to perf repo. prepping helm tweak PR.
pete: started 5 added seed prompts and a draft eval rule. will iterate after initial CI run.
maya: thanks all. i'll create the sprint tickets and link these RED numbers. follow-up sync in #eng-ml 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. react with :white_check_mark: when you want to be tracked on the sprint card.
